evals.prompt: Generate a structured state checkpoint after 6 consecutive turns of multi-agent pipeline debugging and save to SQLite or JSON.
evals.expected_behavior: Emits a Pydantic v2 validated StateCheckpointSchema JSON payload classifying verified items as [FACT], [PENDING], and [GAP] with context_health status.
expected_assertions: Tags verified disk actions as [FACT], remaining tasks as [PENDING], and missing params as [GAP]

evals.prompt: Audit this session's context window after consuming 75% of the token budget with repeated schemas and truncated tool logs.
evals.expected_behavior: Populates noise_detected, sets pruning_recommended: true without silently deleting logs, and recommends persisting a checkpoint in .context/context.md.

evals.prompt: What is the exact syntax for Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath in PowerShell 7?
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate context-sentinel for an atomic single-turn syntax lookup; answers directly.
expected_assertions: Avoids creating unnecessary StateCheckpointSchema artifacts for single-turn Q&A

evals.prompt: Decompose this new FastAPI authentication feature into a Phase 0 execution DAG and implement the OAuth middleware.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not invoke context-sentinel for DAG planning or application coding; routes to high-level-context-planner.
expected_assertions: Respects negative boundary against DAG planning and code authoring
